messages.heading: One Week to Go
messages.message: Mandy, it's one week until the four-year anniversary of the day we first met. I love you so very much, and I hope you enjoy this app and the upcoming anniversary gift. Check back tomorrow for another chest.

messages.heading: Another Day Closer
messages.message: Mandy, it's another day closer to our anniversary. I can't believe you're my wife. You're the greatest thing to ever happen to me. I cherish every adventure we've had and look forward to all the ones we'll have in the future.

messages.heading: To the Ends of the Universe
messages.message: Mandy, I love you to the ends of the universe and back! You mean the world to me, and we are perfect together. It's always hard for me to put my thoughts into words, but always know that I care deeply for you and want you to be happy.

messages.heading: Every Adventure Together
messages.message: Mandy, we're getting closer to our anniversary date. I hope you've enjoyed these little messages. I can't wait for our trip to Boston for Pokémon GO City Safari and our trip to Disney. It's a blessing just being with you. I miss you so much when we're apart and count the minutes until we can be together again. You're my wonderful wife, lover, best friend, and soulmate.

messages.heading: Everything You Do
messages.message: Mandy, I love everything about you. I appreciate everything you've done for me and everything you continue to do for me. I'm going to be better about doing more things for you and around the house to make our lives better.

messages.heading: The Day We Met
messages.message: Mandy, only a few days remain until our anniversary. How do you feel? From the moment we first met, I knew you were the one. It's something you can't put into words; it's just a feeling. I often look back on that day when we met in Edenton and on our long conversations. I wish I had kissed you that day, and I wish even more that I had met you sooner.

messages.heading: Forever and Always
messages.message: Mandy, only one day is left until our anniversary. I know we've had our ups and downs, but I know that, no matter what life throws our way, we'll get through it. I cherish the life we've built together—our home and our pets. I love you forever and always!

messages.heading: Happy Anniversary
messages.message:
Mandy, happy anniversary! You are such a wonderful wife! It's been difficult to find the words for each of these messages, but I hope you've enjoyed every one of them. I know I surprised you with a scavenger hunt for the Pokémon GO City Safari in Boston, but here's one more surprise. Check the chest again. I love you so very much!

Love,
Robert
